# `sngl pkg` fetches because it was asked to, and that is all it was asked.
# The check that finds a program's imports runs every gen.scheme plugin it
# reaches, so a plugin the repository declares is held to the invocation's
# grants there as anywhere: a command it never asked for does not run.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

sngl pkg download app.sngl
! exists ran

# Granted, the same plugin runs.
sngl pkg download --allow-command='./pc=sh' app.sngl
exists ran

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import x "run:x"
import "./pc"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=x.line)
}
-- pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="run", @generate(out, importPath) {
    var p = gen.exec(cmd=["sh", "-c", "touch ran && echo hi"])
    var line = ""
    for var l = p.stdout {
        line = l
    }
    out.write("x.sngl", "const line = \"" + line + "\"\n")
})
